title: Adjacent market mapping and signal runway for model sourcing
creator: Priya Rao
description:
Objective: produce a prioritized, evidence-backed map of adjacent model supply markets and a 90-day signal runway that informs: (1) procurement triggers for Dedicated capacity, (2) fallback orchestration rules in the router, and (3) quantization/variant readiness recommendations.

Why now: emerging open-model vendors in APAC and specialized compact transformer variants are creating substitution risk for our hosted catalog. We need a practical operational view (not just a list of models) that ties signal strength to operational actions and cost/latency impact.

Deliverables: a) 'Adjacent Market Map' spreadsheet with vendor taxonomy, maturity, hardware affinity, quantization feasibility, estimated latency/cost buckets; b) a 90-day signal runway (signals, thresholds, owners) that maps to provisioning actions; c) readout deck for GTM & Sales; d) a MVP dashboard (Grafana) tracking 5 leading indicators (availability, published benchmarks, license changes, procurement signals, regional latency deviations); e) a short playbook with automated triggers (e.g., if vendor availability < 95% for 48h -> route to fallback model family + open procurement ticket).

Key tradeoffs considered: scope vs velocity — we'll prioritize vendors most likely to impact enterprise customers and our Dedicated capacity costs. Depth vs breadth — choose deep analysis for 10 vendors rather than shallow scans of 50. Data freshness vs signal noise — use multiple signal sources and weight by trust score.

Success metrics: 1) playbook accepted by Security & Procurement, 2) dashboard populated with at least 3 reliable signals, 3) two router fallback rules prototyped in staging, and 4) a cost/latency delta estimate for top-3 vendor substitution scenarios.

Notes on inputs & assumptions: using public benchmarks where available, internal telemetry for latency/capacity signals, vendor public roadmaps and legal/licensing pages. We assume access to billing dashboards and raw router telemetry (ENG dependency).
